description: Acquire a declared number of complete count-rate windows and return the ordered observations with their aggregate summary.

deviceId.description: Device that acquires and continuously reports the requested count-rate measurements.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact lease union: only the TimeTagger when latchGuard is disabled, or that TimeTagger plus every network-resolved detector-health guard when it annotates each monitor window.

items.description: One device needed by this monitor.

channelRefs.description: Unique physical or logical channel references monitored in every acquisition window.

items.description: One channel reference accepted by the acquisition device.

measurementDurationSec.description: Integration duration of each acquisition window, in seconds.

windowCount.description: Exact number of complete acquisition windows; null continues until the caller aborts the monitor.

interWindowDelaySec.description: Non-blocking delay between completed acquisition windows, in seconds.

latchGuard.description: Explicit monitor latch policy; annotate retains an invalid window with health evidence and excludes it from valid aggregate statistics rather than retrying it.

mode.description: Whether detector-latch monitoring is disabled or each window is annotated.

acquisition.countrate.observation.window.description: Ordered normalized observations for every completed count-rate window.

acquisition.countrate.observation.latest.description: Normalized context and raw device response for the final completed window over exactly the requested measurement set.

acquisition.countrate.observation.summar.description: Per-measurement valid-window count, missing-window count, latch-invalid-window count, accumulated counts, effective capture duration, and duration-weighted aggregate rate.

acquisition.countrate.status.monitor.description: Current monitor status, timing, and completed-window count. A finite windowCount reaches a terminal result; an unbounded monitor ends through runtime abort and has no terminal result.json.
